question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Incite
solution: The correct answer is '**Inflame**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Incite**' is '**Inflame**'. • **Incite**: to encourage somebody to do something by making him/her very angry or excited. (भड़काना, उकसाना) • *Example: He was accused of **inciting** the crowd to violence.* • **Inflame**: provoke or intensify (strong feelings, especially anger) in someone. [किसी में भड़काना या तीव्र करना (मजबूत भावनाएँ, विशेषकर क्रोध)] • *Example: High fines further **inflamed** public feelings.* **Correct Answer:__** *Inflame.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Pacify**: to make somebody who is angry or upset calm or quiet. (किसी नाराज़ या परेशान व्‍यक्ति को शांत एवं स्थिर करना) • **Tighten**: to become or to make something tight or tighter. (कसना या कस जाना या किसी वस्‍तु को कस देना) • **Quote**: to repeat exactly something that somebody else has said or written before. (पहले कही या लिखी गई बात को सही-सही दोहराना, दूसरे के शब्‍दों को उद्‌धृत करना) 33:Tb87, The correct answer is** 'More than thirty-three million people worldwide are watching this match today.'**
